[EN] I've studied my share of plagues. There are many things about this one that just don't fit.
[ES] He estudiado mi buena porción de plagas. Hay muchas cosas sobre esta que simplemente no encajan.

[EN] At last, some answers!
[ES] ¡Por fin, algunas respuestas!

[EN] Oh, please hurry! Popolion's very fate rides in that cart!"Ready. Let's go!"Go to the caravan.
[ES] ¡Oh, por favor, date prisa! ¡El destino de Popolion depende de ese carro!"Ready. Let's go!"Go to the caravan.
